description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'CustomerSearchFilterParams' used for filtering customer search results within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends a base filter parameters class and provides properties for customer name and IDs, including getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: CustomerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for customers, including sorting options and filtering by name and customer IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'customer.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the customer name filter, if set.

methods.name: getCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns the list of customer IDs filter, if set.

methods.name: setCustomerIds
methods.description: Sets the list of customer IDs filter.
